rules.patternAlternateWeeksDesc: The child switches homes every week, on the day and time you choose.
rules.patternTwoTwoThreeDesc: 2 days with one parent, 2 days with the other, then 3 days (including the weekend). Alternates each week.
rules.patternEveryOtherWeekendDesc: Primary residence with one parent; the other has the child every other weekend (Fri–Sun).
rules.patternCustomDesc: Set up a two-week cycle day by day.
rules.referenceParentLabel: Who has the child at the start?
rules.customCycleLabel: 2-week cycle — click to toggle each day ({{parent}} in blue)
rules.vacSplitHalfDesc: Each holiday period is split in two; the order flips between even and odd years.
rules.vacAlternateFullDesc: The whole period with one parent, alternating by even or odd year.
rules.evenYearFirstHalfLabel: Even years: who gets the first half?
rules.evenYearVacationLabel: Even years: who gets the holidays?
rules.soloNote: You're on your own for now: the calendar already works. Invite the other parent from settings whenever you're ready.
